posts.title: A post about nothing in particular
posts.description: I've been checking the discover feed like a woman obsessed. I have this weird urge to comment on posts I like but it's also freeing to think that this community doesn't rely on comments to denote worth. I'm slowly adding ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ's that inspire me to a little bear-roll page so I can revisit when I need a boost.
